tracks.title: Key levels + VWAP reversion
tracks.source: User-supplied ShamanJohnny Reddit comment; claimed performance unverified
tracks.hypothesis: Test whether an objectively defined extension and failed continuation at predeclared levels predicts reversion after costs.
tracks.source_market: NQ futures; MNQ or an ETF proxy would need a separately specified instrument choice
missing_decisions: Bar timeframe and regular/overnight session anchor
VWAP variance formula and exact extension threshold
Causal definitions of key levels, exhaustion and failed continuation
True bid/ask delta versus an explicitly labeled price-based proxy
Entry, invalidation stop, profit exit and maximum holding time
Per-trade/day/portfolio risk limits and no-new-entry conditions
required_data: Chosen futures contract trades and bid/ask timestamps if futures selected
Warmup, contract reference, session calendar and roll policy
Commissions, spread, slippage, gaps, fills and contract multiplier
tracks.comparison: Separately declared no-delta ablation only if approved before results; cash baseline; net expectancy and drawdown

tracks.title: SPY weekly put / covered-call cycle
tracks.source: User-supplied sellputsthencalls Reddit comment; wheel interpretation, exact rules unconfirmed
tracks.hypothesis: Measure total account return and downside of a fully collateralized weekly SPY options cycle versus comparable SPY buy-and-hold and cash.
tracks.chosen_instrument: SPY listed options and SPY shares; no order or collection activation
missing_decisions: Realistic simulated capital and maximum collateral allocation
Cash-secured puts and share-covered calls only
Entry day/time and exact eligible Friday expiration selection including holidays
Strike selection: moneyness or Greek delta, tie-break rules and data source
Early assignment, exercise, dividends, option multiplier and deliverable handling
Marked-to-market loss limits and gap handling
Fees, spread and conservative option fill model
required_data: Timestamped SPY option chains and bid/ask quotes
Contract multipliers, expirations, deliverables and corporate actions
Option and stock transaction costs and realistic collateral ledger
tracks.comparison: Premium, option liability, stock P&L, dividends, cash yield and total net liquidation value separately; matched buy-and-hold and cash baseline
